<<<application_name>>>
Borrow Checker Quest
<<<end>>>

<<<application_description>>>
A terminal game that teaches ownership through puzzles.
<<<end>>>

<<<application_features>>>
- Levels that teach moves and borrows
* Score tracking
<<<end>>>

<<<code_snippet:Main Code>>>
```rust
fn main() {
    println!("Welcome to Borrow Checker Quest!");
}
```
<<<end>>>

<<<code_snippet:Additional Module 1>>>
pub fn score(level: u32) -> u32 {
    level * 10
}
<<<end>>>
